description: Sign in for the 3 newest salary submissions matching a role and filters. Pay is yearly USD. originalCurrency records the submitted currency. Total matches capped at 250. Never guess slugs. Use search-job-families, search-locations or search-companies. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

locationSlug.description: City, metro, state, country or region.
